text:
🚨 JUST IN: Turkish-American mathematician Levent Alpöge, working with Claude, claims to have proved one of the hardest problems in mathematics: the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis!

The Riemann Hypothesis is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems.

The announcement includes a massive Lean formalization, which, when written out in English, runs to over 250,000 pages! 🤯

If verified, this could be the most significant mathematical breakthrough achieved with AI to date.
